cards.name: Angelic Favor
cards.oracleText:
If you control a Plains, you may tap an untapped creature you control rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
Cast this spell only during combat.
Create a 4/4 white Angel creature token with flying. Exile it at the beginning of the next end step.

cards.name: Crowd's Favor
cards.oracleText:
Convoke (Your creatures can help cast this spell. Each creature you tap while casting this spell pays for {1} or one mana of that creature's color.)
Target creature gets +1/+0 and gains first strike until end of turn. (It deals combat damage before creatures without first strike.)

cards.name: Favorable Destiny
cards.oracleText:
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature gets +1/+2 as long as it's white.
Enchanted creature has shroud as long as its controller controls another creature. (It can't be the target of spells or abilities.)

cards.name: Etali's Favor
cards.oracleText:
Enchant creature you control
When this Aura enters, discover 3. (Exile cards from the top of your library until you exile a nonland card with mana value 3 or less. Cast it without paying its mana cost or put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom in a random order.)
Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 and has trample.

cards.name: Foster
cards.oracleText: Whenever a creature you control dies, you may pay {1}. If you do, reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card. Put that card into your hand and the rest into your graveyard.

cards.name: Favored Hoplite
cards.oracleText: Heroic — Whenever you cast a spell that targets this creature, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature and prevent all damage that would be dealt to it this turn.

cards.name: Favorable Winds
cards.oracleText: Creatures you control with flying get +1/+1.

cards.name: Planeswalker's Favor
cards.oracleText: {3}{G}: Target opponent reveals a card at random from their hand. Target creature gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the revealed card's mana value.

cards.name: Favored of Iroas
cards.oracleText: Constellation — Whenever an enchantment you control enters, this creature gains double strike until end of turn. (It deals both first-strike and regular combat damage.)

cards.name: Pack's Favor
cards.oracleText:
Convoke (Your creatures can help cast this spell. Each creature you tap while casting this spell pays for {1} or one mana of that creature's color.)
Target creature gets +3/+3 until end of turn.

cards.name: Favor of Jukai
cards.oracleText:
Enchant artifact or creature
As long as enchanted permanent is a creature, it gets +3/+3 and has reach.
Channel — {1}{G}, Discard this card: Target creature gets +3/+3 and gains reach until end of turn.

cards.name: Favor of the Mighty
cards.oracleText: Each creature with the greatest mana value has protection from each color.

cards.name: Favor of the Woods
cards.oracleText:
Enchant creature
Whenever enchanted creature blocks, you gain 3 life.

cards.name: Fortune's Favor
cards.oracleText: Target opponent looks at the top four cards of your library and separates them into a face-down pile and a face-up pile. Put one pile into your hand and the other into your graveyard.

cards.name: Jolrael's Favor
cards.oracleText:
Flash
Enchant creature
{1}{G}: Regenerate enchanted creature.

cards.name: Hazoret's Favor
cards.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may have target creature you control get +2/+0 and gain haste until end of turn. If you do, sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step.

cards.name: Favored Enemy
cards.oracleText:
As this enchantment enters, note the most prevalent creature type in an opponent's library.
When this enchantment enters, target creature you control fights up to one target creature you don't control.
Whenever a creature an opponent controls of the noted type dies, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control.

cards.name: Favor of the Overbeing
cards.oracleText:
Enchant creature
As long as enchanted creature is green, it gets +1/+1 and has vigilance.
As long as enchanted creature is blue, it gets +1/+1 and has flying.
